_comment: Named link profiles of the echo hub (echo_impair.py). Delays are one way, per direction. loss is the chance in the good state; burst_enter/burst_exit move between the good and the bad state per datagram, burst_loss is the chance in the bad state. bandwidth_bps 0 = unlimited; buffer_ms is the queue depth before a tail drop. Seeds are not part of a profile: the hub takes --seed N.
